title: Three Vertex
overview: What happens when someone tries to belong in a place where they don't fit in?  Imagine spending your whole life living under a different fake identity, trying to fit into a cult group just to achieve your ultimate goal, the same goal that'll let you live, only to end up failing on what matters most and completely losing yourself. A cult, a leader marked as God, masks, hidden identities and fake promises disguised as glory. All in one story, one character.
